subject: Re: Kickoff: GHUM synthetic-human asset for the data platform
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Quentin owns the model retraining, Saoirse the sampling API, Paloma the scan-data pipeline. All three at 60-80% through the window.

Compute: retraining the VAE shape spaces against the gender-specific scan sets (4,329 male and female body scans) plus the pose-space deformation correctives is the expensive part. I am budgeting a Vulcan H100 reservation for three weeks in May - note Vulcan needs reservation through Ines, and there is a maintenance window 6/22-6/24 we should stay clear of anyway.

Money: Idris has verbally earmarked $180k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-74 for this project, and my reservation plan assumes the full amount. Idris, cc'd so the paperwork follows the verbal.

One gap: hand-articulation closeup scans are thinner than body scans; Paloma is auditing coverage now.

Alina
